title: Storyboard
description: Reviewable beat timeline produced before asset generation. Each beat carries its own duration, on-screen label, optional voiceover line, timestamped SFX cues, and music-duck points. The human approves this beat timeline BEFORE the assets stage spends on generation or render.

total_seconds.description: Total runtime of the storyboard in seconds.

music_bed.description: Path or asset-manifest ID of the background music bed for the whole timeline.

on_screen.description: Short label describing what is visible on screen during this beat.

vo.description: Voiceover / narration line spoken during this beat.

sfx.description: Sound-effect cues placed at timestamps relative to the start of this beat.

music.description: Music-duck points placed at timestamps relative to the start of this beat.

level_db.description: Target music-bed level in dB at this point (negative = ducked below nominal).

reason.description: Why the music ducks here (e.g. VO onset, SFX hit).
